hold_conditions: Retain the XNGUSD analytical watch only if the next independent balance evidence confirms the mechanism; require current curve and cost checks before a separate holding decision.

horizon_blocks.outlook: XNGUSD conditional short outlook: Over five sessions, identify the next actual release/quote reaction and distinguish a surprise from carry or position adjustment. The original EIA injection of 67 Bcf versus a 90 Bcf same-week seasonal average tightens the weekly refill by 23 Bcf; stocks still sit 45 Bcf above the five-year level. Confirmation required: Next storage releases, weather-normalized demand, production/LNG exports, current gas curve and pre-release consensus; no admitted exact gas price history. No target or probability is estimated.

XNGUSD conditional swing outlook: Over 21 sessions, require repeat releases and relative price/curve confirmation before retaining the proposed transmission. The original EIA injection of 67 Bcf versus a 90 Bcf same-week seasonal average tightens the weekly refill by 23 Bcf; stocks still sit 45 Bcf above the five-year level. Confirmation required: Next storage releases, weather-normalized demand, production/LNG exports, current gas curve and pre-release consensus; no admitted exact gas price history. No target or probability is estimated.

XNGUSD conditional long outlook: Over 63 sessions, compare cumulative cash-flow, supply/demand or policy changes with valuation and annualized vehicle costs; an old price pattern is insufficient. The original EIA injection of 67 Bcf versus a 90 Bcf same-week seasonal average tightens the weekly refill by 23 Bcf; stocks still sit 45 Bcf above the five-year level. Confirmation required: Next storage releases, weather-normalized demand, production/LNG exports, current gas curve and pre-release consensus; no admitted exact gas price history. No target or probability is estimated.

invalidation_conditions: Invalidate the XNGUSD analytical watch if subsequent balances reverse the proposed tightening, the regional basis prevents transmission, or required current evidence remains unavailable.
limitations: CC analysis is not external confirmation or an order.
No private holdings/account context is included.
